<div>
    <cfquery name="q" datasource="#application.dsn#">
    SELECT id
    FROM   people
    <cfset var filter = {
        kind: arguments.kind, // the caller's kind
        status: 'active'
    }>
    <cfset var ids = arguments.ids.map(function(id) {
        return val(id);
    })>
    <cfif len(filter.kind) /* set */ and structKeyExists(arguments, 'statusCodeForThePersonRecord')>
    WHERE  kind = <cfqueryparam value="#filter.kind#" cfsqltype="cf_sql_varchar" maxlength="50" null="#not len(filter.kind)#">
    </cfif>
    </cfquery>
</div>
